hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى يَقْرَأُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ وَيَنْفِثُ ، قَالَتْ : فَلَمَّا اشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ كُنْتُ أَنَا أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَمْسَحُ عَلَيْهِ بِيَمِينِهِ رَجَاءَ بَرَكَتِهَا
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Aisha: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would complain of illness, he would recite upon himself with the Mu'awwidhat (the protective surahs) and blow. She said: When his pain intensified, I would recite upon him and wipe over him with his right hand, hoping for its blessing.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ دَخَلَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ وَهِيَ تَشْتَكِي وَيَهُودِيَّةٌ تَرْقِيهَا ، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ : ارْقِيهَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq entered upon Aisha while she was complaining of illness and a Jewish woman was performing ruqyah (spiritual healing) upon her. Abu Bakr said: 'Perform ruqyah upon her with the Book of Allah.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَصَابَهُ جُرْحٌ فَاحْتَقَنَ الْجُرْحُ الدَّمَ ، وَأَنَّ الرَّجُلَ دَعَا رَجُلَيْنِ مِنْ بَنِي أَنْمَارٍ فَنَظَرَا إِلَيْهِ ، فَزَعَمَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ لَهُمَا : أَيُّكُمَا أَطَبُّ ؟ فَقَالَا : أَوَ فِي الطِّبِّ خَيْرٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ؟ فَزَعَمَ زَيْدٌ : أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : أَنْزَلَ الدَّوَاءَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ الْأَدْوَاءَ. وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي ، أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ زُرَارَةَ اكْتَوَى فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنَ الذُّبْحَةِ فَمَاتَ. وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ اكْتَوَى مِنَ اللَّقْوَةِ وَرُقِيَ مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Zayd ibn Aslam: A man in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was wounded and the blood congealed in the wound. The man called two men from Banu Anmaar who examined him. They claimed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: 'Which of you is more skilled in medicine?' They said: 'Is there good in medicine, O Messenger of Allah?' Zayd claimed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'He who sent down the disease also sent down the cure.' // Narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id who said: It reached me that Sa'd ibn Zurarah was cauterized in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for throat disease and he died. // Narrated from Nafi': Abdullah ibn Umar was cauterized for facial paralysis and was treated with ruqyah for scorpion sting.

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ ، أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ كَانَتْ إِذَا أُتِيَتْ بِالْمَرْأَةِ وَقَدْ حُمَّتْ تَدْعُو لَهَا ، أَخَذَتِ الْمَاءَ فَصَبَّتْهُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ جَيْبِهَا ، وَقَالَتْ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نُبْرِدَهَا بِالْمَاءِ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Fatimah bint al-Mundhir: Asma bint Abi Bakr, when a woman with fever was brought to her and she supplicated for her, would take water and pour it between her (the sick woman's body) and her garment. She said: 'Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command us to cool it (the fever) with water.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَطْفِئُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَرِيضَ خَاضَ الرَّحْمَةَ حَتَّى إِذَا قَعَدَ عِنْدَهُ قَرَّتْ فِيهِ

حَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَرِيضَ خَاضَ الرَّحْمَةَ حَتَّى إِذَا قَعَدَ عِنْدَهُ قَرَّتْ فِيهِ ، أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذَا
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When a man visits a sick person, he wades through mercy until when he sits with him, it settles upon him,' or something similar to this.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ ، عَنْ ابْنِ عَطِيَّةَ ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : لَا عَدْوَى وَلَا هَامَ وَلَا صَفَرَ ، وَلَا يَحُلَّ الْمُمْرِضُ عَلَى الْمُصِحِّ ، وَلْيَحْلُلِ الْمُصِحُّ حَيْثُ شَاءَ ، فَقَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا ذَاكَ ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : إِنَّهُ أَذًى
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Ibn Atiyyah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There is no contagion (adwa), no evil omen from owls (haam), and no superstition about the month of Safar. The one with sick (camels) should not stop near the one with healthy (camels), but the one with healthy (camels) may stop wherever he wishes.' They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what is that?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'It is a harm.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَامَ حَجَّ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ، وَتَنَاوَلَ قُصَّةً مِنْ شَعَرٍ كَانَتْ فِي يَدِ حَرَسِيٍّ ، يَقُولُ : يَا أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ أَيْنَ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ ؟ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَنْهَى عَنْ مِثْلِ هَذِهِ ، وَيَقُولُ : إِنَّمَا هَلَكَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ حِينَ اتَّخَذَ هَذِهِ نِسَاؤُهُمْ. وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ : سَدَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَاصِيَتَهُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ، ثُمَّ فَرَقَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf: He heard Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan in the year he performed Hajj while he was upon the pulpit, and he took a lock of hair that was in the hand of a guard, saying: 'O people of Madinah, where are your scholars? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbid the like of this and say: The Bani Israel only perished when their women adopted this (hair extensions).' // Narrated from Ibn Shihab: He heard him (Ibn Shihab) say: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ let his forelock hang down for as long as Allah willed, then he parted it after that.'

potential_issues.issue: Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri is classified as mudallis (category 3 in Ibn Hajar's classification) and uses the term 'عَنْ' (an) in the first chain
potential_issues.impact: Al-Zuhri is widely considered extremely reliable and trustworthy by the vast majority of scholars despite his tadlis. His narrations are generally accepted even with 'an. This does not significantly affect the reliability of the first hadith.

potential_issues.issue: The second narration is mursal - Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri reports directly about the Prophet ﷺ without naming the companion
potential_issues.impact: This creates a break in the chain as the companion source is unknown. Mursal narrations are considered weak by the majority of scholars.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ الْإِخْصَاءَ ، وَيَقُولُ : فِيهِ تَمَامُ الْخَلْقِ
hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Abdullah ibn Umar: He used to dislike castration and would say: 'In it (the reproductive organ) is the completion of creation.'
